title: "comparing_s100_and_hla_nFeature"
format: html
editor: visual
---


```{r}
tab1 <- seurat_monocytes |> select(sampleID,nFeature_RNA,nCount_RNA,days_after_onset, donor, origID, sampletag, disease_stage,cluster_clean ,group_per_sample) 

dings <- tab1 |>filter(disease_stage !="control",cluster_clean %in% c("hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes",
                                                                      "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes")) |>  group_by(sampleID, cluster_clean) |>
  mutate(features_per_count=nFeature_RNA/nCount_RNA) |> #nonsense for nonlinear relationship
  summarise(mean_nFeature=mean(nFeature_RNA),                                                                                          mean_nCount=mean(nCount_RNA),
            mean_features_per_count=mean(features_per_count)) 

dings |> ggplot(aes(cluster_clean,mean_nFeature, colour = cluster_clean)) +geom_point() + geom_line(aes(group =sampleID ))+
  
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+ylim(0,5000)


dings |> ggplot(aes(cluster_clean,mean_nCount)) +geom_point() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+ geom_line(aes(group =sampleID ))+ylim(0,17000)


dings |> ggplot(aes(cluster_clean,mean_nCount)) +
  geom_point() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  geom_line(aes(group =sampleID ))+ylim(0,17000)

dings |>
  ggplot(aes(cluster_clean,mean_nCount)) +
  geom_point() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  geom_line(aes(group =sampleID ))+ylim(0,17000)
```

```{r}
tab1 |>filter(disease_stage !="control",cluster_clean %in% c("hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes",
                                                                      "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes")) |> ggplot(aes(log(nFeature_RNA),log(nCount_RNA), cluster_clean, colour = cluster_clean)) +geom_smooth() + facet_wrap(~ sampleID, scales = "free")
```

```{r}
seurat_monocytes |> DimPlot(group.by = "Phase")
VlnPlot(object = seurat_monocytes,features = )

        features = "G2M.Score",
        group.by = "sampleID")

seurat_monocytes|>filter(disease_stage !="control",cluster_clean %in% c("hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes",
                                                                      "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes")) |> group_by(sampleID, cluster_clean) |> summarise(mean_g2m=mean(G2M.Score)) |> ggplot(aes(cluster_clean,mean_g2m)) + geom_point()


seurat_monocytes |>filter(disease_stage !="control",cluster_clean %in% c("hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes",
                                                                      "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes")) |> group_by(sampleID, cluster_clean) |> summarise(mean_S.Score=mean(S.Score)) |> ggplot(aes(cluster_clean,mean_S.Score)) + geom_point()
```
